implementedChanges: Missing or faulting Fault.code retrieval falls back to a safe allowlisted report code.
Local IO threads propagate original exception objects without generic reclassification.
Local fixture close retains original per-stage errors privately, attempts later owned cleanup, and rethrows the first interruption or first original error.
Direct close tests retain budget and remaining-stream assertions while expecting original exception propagation.

blockingFixture.observed: Synthetic Broken exception invokes inherited Fault constructor, which reads its deliberately failing code getter before safe_error is called.
blockingFixture.proposedMinimalChange: Override only the synthetic exception constructor using Exception.__init__, retaining the faulting getter and all assertions.

synchronization: Sanitized checkpoint only; no private prototype source, raw exception messages or runtime credentials released.
